title: Bengaluru's Majestic bus station was built on a lake. What happened to the city's lakes?
description:
Kempegowda Bus Station (Majestic) opened in 1969 on the bed of Dharmambudhi lake, drained in the early 1900s. Sampangi, Challaghatta and Koramangala lakes became a stadium, a golf course and a housing layout, and Greater Bengaluru's lake area fell from 2,342 ha in 1973 to 918 ha in 2007, about 61%.
Built-over lakes and blocked storm-water channels (rajakaluves) are one reason experts link to the city's floods.

Sources: Wikipedia (Kempegowda Bus Station); Nagendra and Unnikrishnan, Arcadia 2019; The News Minute, 28 May 2016; Ramachandra and Kumar 2008 via Citizen Matters, 11 Jan 2016. Lake counts vary by source. Some scenes are AI visualisation. Educational content, not advice.
